title: Preserved source representation is not automatically raw-source materialization
failure_signature: Readable content is silently relabeled raw-materialized, raw state is inferred without verified raw bytes, orchestration requires source-pack/PDF download before already preserved claim content may enter Evidence, or locator existence alone is treated as claim proof.
root_cause: Source identity, actually read claim content, preserved representation bytes and byte-identical upstream raw bytes were conflated, allowing transport mechanics to manufacture epistemic state or block research.
invariant: New logical documents begin locator_verified. content_verified requires actually read claim-relevant content plus a faithful representation and may support Evidence without raw bytes. materialized requires an explicit raw=true fetch bound to raw_materialized_document_version_id. A document version alone never proves raw materialization. Orchestration v2 consumes verified prepared material without requiring Release/source-pack/PDF download; legacy v1 stays replay compatibility only.
anti_regression: Do not default source_capture_state to materialized or let any document-version trigger imply raw bytes.
Do not allow materialized state without raw_materialized_document_version_id.
Do not infer raw=true when adapter provenance is missing; supported adapters must say raw=true or raw=false.
Do not label a readable-representation digest as a raw-PDF hash unless raw bytes were verified.
Do not let locator_verified support claim Evidence when relevant content was never read.
Do not require --source-pack or GitHub Release for research-orchestration/v2 or later default execution.
Do not rewrite legacy Release/source-pack receipts when transport policy changes; preserve replayability.

guards.description: New logical documents start locator-only rather than fabricated raw state.
Materialized state requires an explicit raw document version.
Deferred raw materialization is an explicit verified transition.
Default execution consumes prepared material rather than a Release pack.
Readable representations persist truthful non-raw provenance.
Regression locks explicit raw and version-scoped materialization.

revisit_when: Only if a richer source-material graph still preserves separate logical source identity, read claim content, representation bytes and explicit raw-byte materialization without transport-specific Evidence prerequisites.
